resize_tensor: resize a PyTorch tensor to a specified size using nearest or bilinear interpolation
resize_with_scale_factor: resize a PyTorch tensor by a scale factor instead of an absolute target size
resize_with_align_corners_warning: resize a tensor with align_corners enabled and get warnings about misaligned dimensions
resize_bilinear: resize a PyTorch tensor using bilinear interpolation mode for smoother results
review_resize_wrapper: review the resize wrapper function that delegates to F.interpolate with optional alignment warnings
